mapper.select:
SELECT r.id as storedRecordId, r.warehouse as warehouseId, w.name as warehouseName, r.goods as goodsId, r.nums as stockNum FROM room r LEFT JOIN warehouse w ON r.warehouse = w.id WHERE r.goods IN
#{goodsId}

SELECT bi.id as id, bi.pid as pid, b.goods as goodsId, g.protect as protectDays,
CASE WHEN bi.type = 'buy' THEN buy.mfd WHEN bi.type = 'sell' THEN sell.mfd WHEN bi.type = 'bre' THEN bre.mfd WHEN bi.type = 'sre' THEN sre.mfd WHEN bi.type = 'swap' THEN swap.mfd WHEN bi.type = 'entry' THEN entry.mfd WHEN bi.type = 'extry' THEN extry.mfd ELSE b.time END as produceDate,
CASE WHEN g.protect > 0 THEN DATE_ADD( CASE WHEN bi.type = 'buy' THEN buy.mfd WHEN bi.type = 'sell' THEN sell.mfd WHEN bi.type = 'bre' THEN bre.mfd WHEN bi.type = 'sre' THEN sre.mfd WHEN bi.type = 'swap' THEN swap.mfd WHEN bi.type = 'entry' THEN entry.mfd WHEN bi.type = 'extry' THEN extry.mfd ELSE b.time END, INTERVAL g.protect DAY ) ELSE NULL END as expireDate,
CASE WHEN bi.direction = 1 THEN ABS(bi.nums) ELSE -ABS(bi.nums) END as nums
FROM batch_info bi LEFT JOIN batch b ON bi.pid = b.id LEFT JOIN goods g ON b.goods = g.id
LEFT JOIN buy_info buy ON bi.info = buy.id AND bi.type = 'buy'
LEFT JOIN sell_info sell ON bi.info = sell.id AND bi.type = 'sell'
LEFT JOIN bre_info bre ON bi.info = bre.id AND bi.type = 'bre'
LEFT JOIN sre_info sre ON bi.info = sre.id AND bi.type = 'sre'
LEFT JOIN swap_info swap ON bi.info = swap.id AND bi.type = 'swap'
LEFT JOIN entry_info entry ON bi.info = entry.id AND bi.type = 'entry'
LEFT JOIN extry_info extry ON bi.info = extry.id AND bi.type = 'extry' WHERE bi.pid IN
#{batchId}
ORDER BY bi.pid, produceDate DESC, bi.direction DESC

SELECT bi.id as documentId,
CASE WHEN bi.type = 'buy' THEN buy.warehouse WHEN bi.type = 'sell' THEN sell.warehouse WHEN bi.type = 'bre' THEN bre.warehouse WHEN bi.type = 'sre' THEN sre.warehouse WHEN bi.type = 'swap' THEN CASE WHEN bi.direction = 1 THEN swap.storehouse ELSE swap.warehouse END WHEN bi.type = 'entry' THEN entry.warehouse WHEN bi.type = 'extry' THEN extry.warehouse ELSE NULL END as warehouseId,
CASE WHEN bi.type = 'buy' THEN w_buy.name WHEN bi.type = 'sell' THEN w_sell.name WHEN bi.type = 'bre' THEN w_bre.name WHEN bi.type = 'sre' THEN w_sre.name WHEN bi.type = 'swap' THEN CASE WHEN bi.direction = 1 THEN w_swap_in.name ELSE w_swap_out.name END WHEN bi.type = 'entry' THEN w_entry.name WHEN bi.type = 'extry' THEN w_extry.name ELSE NULL END as warehouseName,
b.goods as goodsId,
ABS(bi.nums) as stockNum
FROM batch_info bi LEFT JOIN batch b ON bi.pid = b.id LEFT JOIN goods g ON b.goods = g.id
LEFT JOIN buy_info buy ON bi.info = buy.id AND bi.type = 'buy' LEFT JOIN warehouse w_buy ON buy.warehouse = w_buy.id LEFT JOIN sell_info sell ON bi.info = sell.id AND bi.type = 'sell' LEFT JOIN warehouse w_sell ON sell.warehouse = w_sell.id LEFT JOIN bre_info bre ON bi.info = bre.id AND bi.type = 'bre' LEFT JOIN warehouse w_bre ON bre.warehouse = w_bre.id LEFT JOIN sre_info sre ON bi.info = sre.id AND bi.type = 'sre' LEFT JOIN warehouse w_sre ON sre.warehouse = w_sre.id LEFT JOIN swap_info swap ON bi.info = swap.id AND bi.type = 'swap' LEFT JOIN warehouse w_swap_out ON swap.warehouse = w_swap_out.id LEFT JOIN warehouse w_swap_in ON swap.storehouse = w_swap_in.id LEFT JOIN entry_info entry ON bi.info = entry.id AND bi.type = 'entry' LEFT JOIN warehouse w_entry ON entry.warehouse = w_entry.id LEFT JOIN extry_info extry ON bi.info = extry.id AND bi.type = 'extry' LEFT JOIN warehouse w_extry ON extry.warehouse = w_extry.id WHERE bi.pid IN
#{batchId}
AND ( (bi.type = 'buy' AND buy.warehouse IS NOT NULL) OR (bi.type = 'sell' AND sell.warehouse IS NOT NULL) OR (bi.type = 'bre' AND bre.warehouse IS NOT NULL) OR (bi.type = 'sre' AND sre.warehouse IS NOT NULL) OR (bi.type = 'swap' AND (swap.warehouse IS NOT NULL OR swap.storehouse IS NOT NULL)) OR (bi.type = 'entry' AND entry.warehouse IS NOT NULL) OR (bi.type = 'extry' AND extry.warehouse IS NOT NULL) ) ORDER BY bi.id, warehouseId
